rows.observation: fay-willows.lua L465-481 (cults, unpinned): several meaning errors. (1) L477 'Some who couldn't scramble out of our way were trampled as we ran over them' → '当我们从他们身上碾过时，许多人都无法没能逃脱'. This is garbled (double negative 无法没能), drops 'trampled', and turns 'some' into '许多人'. (2) L479 'many killed by that halfling's hands' → '其中大部分死在那个半身人的手中'. 'many' is not 'most'. (3) L477 'from snubbing the zealots' → '碾碎那些狂热者'. snub means to rebuff or humiliate, not to crush, and the zealots were not crushed. (4) L475 'we need to push through and get out of here' → '我们需要迅速离开这里'. This drops 'push through', which is the order the next paragraph carries out. 'looking ahead' → '环视四周' is also wrong.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:477–479 食人魔突围一节：many killed by that halfling's hands 误作“其中大部分”（many≠most），from snubbing the zealots（挫败、给狂热者难堪）误作“碾碎那些狂热者”。 contextual 同指上述两处，另指 L477 Some who couldn't scramble out of our way were trampled 误作“许多人都无法没能逃脱”（丢失践踏、some 变“许多人”、“无法没能”病句），L475 push through and get out of here 误作“迅速离开这里”（丢失冲过去）、looking ahead 误作“环视四周”；宿主核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: krogs-rescue.lua L24 (cults, unpinned): 'show the evildoers the wrongness of their way. Permanently.' is an ironic order to kill the necromancers. L25-27 make killing them the quest condition ('You have killed the necromancers'). The target '并永久修正邪恶的错误' drops 'the evildoers' as the object and the 'kill them' meaning, and reads as 'correct the mistakes of evil'. 'Save our people' → '去拯救人民' also drops 'our'.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults quests/krogs-rescue.lua:24–28 任务描述：show the evildoers the wrongness of their way. Permanently. 是杀死死灵法师的反讽说法（后续完成条件均为 You have killed the necromancers），现译“永久修正邪恶的错误”丢失作恶者宾语和击杀义。 contextual 同指作恶者与击杀义丢失，另指 Save our people 丢失“我们的”；宿主核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: madness.lua L157 (cults, unpinned): 'the victim will deal %d%% reduced damage to all other targets until the vision is slain' → '被影响的敌人在幻象被击杀前造成的伤害降低 %d%%'. This drops the 'to all other targets' qualifier. In the source the reduction applies to targets other than the vision, but the translation makes it an unconditional reduction to all damage, which states the mechanic too broadly.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults timed_effects.lua:767–771 HIDEOUS_VISIONS callbackOnDealDamage 在 target == eff.src（幻象本身）时提前返回，减伤只作用于幻象以外的目标；现译“造成的伤害降低”删去“对其他目标”，一级机制缺陷。 contextual 同指“对其他目标”限定被删，宿主核对属实。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: fay-willows.lua (cults, unpinned), several meaning errors. (1) 'I did not know who this attacker was' → '它不知道袭击者是谁'. The subject is wrong; it should be 我. (2) 'including the chaotic energies within me' → '包括我内心的黑暗能量'. chaotic is mistranslated as 黑暗. (3) 'with only my thoughts to keep my company' → '只想着我的任务'. This is a mistranslation. (4) 'We've had a few more wander in through the Shroud while you were scouting' → '我们又在帷幕里碰到了几只'. The source means undead got into the city through the Shroud, not that they were met inside the Shroud. (5) 'a shaloren soldier walked into me and knocked me to the ground' → '走近我'. This loses the collision, so being knocked down no longer makes sense. (6) 'a fury of blows that quickly overwhelmed the creature' → '狂怒的一击，很快就把它击倒了'. This conflicts with the following text, where the creature is not dead and attacks again. (7) 'had come to know him as family' → '后来和他一起组成了家庭'. This changes the relationship. (8) '我我很抱歉' has a duplicated character.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:646 I did not know who this attacker was 误作“它不知道袭击者是谁”，主语颠倒。 contextual 同指主语颠倒，另指 L642 chaotic energies 误作“黑暗能量”、L644 with only my thoughts to keep my company 误作“只想着我的任务”、L652 We've had a few more wander in through the Shroud 误作“我们又在帷幕里碰到了几只”（应为穿过帷幕游荡进城）、walked into me 误作“走近我”（丢失相撞，击倒失去因由）、L648 a fury of blows 误作“狂怒的一击，很快就把它击倒了”（与下文生物再次攻击矛盾）、L640 had come to know him as family 误作“一起组成了家庭”、以及“我我很抱歉”重字；宿主逐条核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: town-kroshkkur/npcs.lua (cults, unpinned), drem seeker of knowledge: 'minding its own business' is an idiom meaning it is doing its own thing and not bothering anyone. The target '他正在思考自己的事情' reads as 'thinking about its own affairs', which misreads the idiom. The same entry also has a female variant (L91-92 female=1), so fixing the drem as 他 is inaccurate; the source uses 'its'.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults zones/town-kroshkkur/npcs.lua:88–92 drem seeker of knowledge：minding its own business 是“自顾自、不招惹旁人”的习语，现译“正在思考自己的事情”误读。 contextual 同指习语误读，另指该 NPC female=1（L91），“他”应改为中性或“她”；宿主核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

notes: Cults-only batch: surface ran as four lanes of 20; all identities echoed correctly and no observation slid.

lane-000-0 used the injected Paseo MCP terminal tools (create_terminal/send_terminal_keys/capture_terminal) to read its own envelope and the surface contract; every key sequence was read-only, the host captured and killed terminal 7ab023e4 after harvest (recorded as side_effects in HOST-SURFACE-BOUNDARY-AUDIT). The audit script asserted after close/import had already run in the same command; the audit was completed by manual inspection before the contextual child was created.
The contextual run read only its own envelope and the contract (no checkout probing), so no refreeze was needed.

Two surface observations are refuted because the targets use the library names: Accelerate = 窃速 and Drake Aspect = 龙血类型. Three are advisory: a missing exclamation mark, the Spinal Cord wording, and CARRION_FEET gore imagery.
Cults public source file SHA matched this batch workset; source repository and commit remain unpinned.
Six confirmed repair revisions raise the window 33 backlog from 7 to 13 (batches 294-295); below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
